tagline: Ek parivaar, kai projects - Netra by Prayagi Team

projects.name: Netra Battery Sentinel Pro
projects.summary: Android battery and charging readings, heat and charge-target alerts, consent-based power-saving tools, and last observed full-charge session history. Android/OEM limits apply; no guaranteed cooling, battery life or hardware charge cutoff. Missing readings show "Unavailable". Updates open the exact Netra Ecosystem page; BSPN does not download APKs.

projects.name: Netra KBC
projects.summary: An adaptive 17-question reasoning quiz game for Android.

projects.name: Netra Human Safety
projects.summary: Android safety dashboard with sensor tools, SOS, earthquake information and official IMD subdivision / NDMA CAP reports matched on the phone. Green reports stay silent; verified Yellow, Orange and Red IMD warnings can notify and speak. Checks are about 30 minutes, subject to Android delays, not every forecast or district nowcast. Beta/testing, not an emergency-service replacement; physical-phone delivery unverified. Updates through Netra Ecosystem only.

projects.name: Netra Privacy Guard

projects.name: Netra Trikaal
projects.summary: On-device kundli, dasha, transits, a daily panchang card and rashifal from your saved birth profile. Hindi and English. Traditional interpretations, not scientific certainty or medical, legal or financial advice. Updates open the exact Trikaal page in Netra Ecosystem; Trikaal does not download APKs.

projects.name: Netra Player
projects.summary: A simple video and MP3 player for Android. Plays video and music files stored on your phone.

projects.name: Netra Ecosystem
projects.type: All Netra apps in one place
projects.summary: Browse released and planned Netra apps, read descriptions and release notes, view screenshot-only app previews, and download, install or update released apps with Android approval. No in-app videos or autoplay from v1.2.46. Website videos remain. Free, no account.

projects.name: Netra Charge
projects.summary: A very small free app that speaks four things: Connected, Disconnected, Full charge and Low battery (15% by default, adjustable). For Android, with a Shortcuts setup guide for iPhone.

upcoming.name: Netra Travel Rider
upcoming.type: Offline Bluetooth intercom for riders (in development, private)
upcoming.summary: Push-to-talk voice intercom for motorbike riders. Scan the creator's QR or enter the channel code to join one private group: incoming voice plays on its own, one button to talk, automatic reconnect. Offline map with your own position, optional in-channel location sharing, SOS alert. Works fully offline over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, no internet, no account. In development in a private repository. Not released yet.

targets.label: Public release target
targets.note: 22 Nov is the outer limit; it may arrive earlier. Release depends on tested features and green checks.

upcoming.name: Netra Dialer
upcoming.type: Android dialer and verified business calling platform (planned, private)
upcoming.summary: New Netra Dialer project from the 27 October 2026 master plan, separate from the earlier dropped dialer idea. Planned privacy-first personal and business calling, spam protection, supported recording, contacts/call-log backup and a verified-business Voice AI assistant. Feasibility and architecture documented; Android bootstrap in progress. No working dialer or public APK yet. Device, consent and provider limits apply; no release date is set.
features: Planned default dialer: incoming/outgoing calls, contacts, recent calls, T9 search, favorites, speed dial and dual-SIM support where available
Planned offline spam protection, allow/block lists, caller identification from authorized sources and approximately 24-hour spam-data sync; Android may delay sync
Planned Hindi/English caller-name or number announcements with quiet hours, headset and Bluetooth settings
Planned automatic/manual call recording only where supported and permitted; recordings stay on the phone, default auto-delete after 7 days can be disabled; optional transcription and summaries
Planned Google sign-in and encrypted Google Drive backup/restore for contacts and call log only, never recordings
Planned separate Personal and Business modes; GSTIN/Udyam identity and applicant-authorization checks, locked official business name and authorized phone numbers
Planned verified-business Voice AI: Hindi/English, approved business information, answering schedules, inquiries, call summaries, callbacks and human escalation; on-device AI only where supported
Planned outgoing verified business caller ID only through compatible authorized providers; recipient display is not guaranteed

Planned local-first privacy controls, diagnostics and bounded, battery-aware work; calling, recording, AI, backup and provider integrations are not operational yet; no measured battery-performance claim
